description: Starts reading the business again from the web, as business_read_quote priced it: setup's own read of its address and pages, on the owner's tokens. Only after you said the price from business_read_quote and the owner said yes to it in the message you are answering now; refused in the same message as the quote, without a quote, or when the price moved since (quote again). Nothing it finds counts until the owner confirms it on the review. It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

owner_words.description: The owner's own words, exactly as they said them: what an argument ending in _from_message keeps.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

yes_from_message.description: true: the owner's message you are answering is their yes to the price business_read_quote gave, said to them in your last reply
